claim_limits: The journey runs the production native DIA session path (`initializeDIANativeImport`: on-disk reference states from import onward, in-process reference kernels) switched on by the KIT journey launch record, so every step is snapshotted after its own step.
A production-default journey (no launch record, in-memory WorkflowState) has no per-step references; KIT-005 runs one such member as the memory baseline and cannot fingerprint it per step.
journey.ceiling_note: KIT-005 / protocol v1.2: data steps scale about 20 x from 8 to 300 samples (attempt 1: q-value 296 s, evidence 190 s); 4 h, the protocol maximum

oracle_canonical_form.note: KIT-012 pre-step: state fingerprints recomputed from control-1's store under the current canonical form (KIT-011 correction 1, KIT-008 correction 2) and overlaid on the in-run record; the in-run per-step assets are kept

fault.name: after_aggregate
fault.error_pattern: CORE-004 forced failure after the aggregate stage
fault.mechanism: the worker's phase hook raises after the ordered result stage completes; the action completes as worker_failed and the head stays on the input

fault.name: guard_after_intensity
fault.mechanism: application-guard-inject.rds written after the intensity filter (the first post-rollup step) completes; the application monitor stops the slice (injected_guard_stop); the sample-filter step fails on disconnection; the head must equal the intensity-filter snapshot
